results.title: FISCAL 2026 BUDGET JUSTIFICATION
results.content: The Library of Congress is submitting its fi scal 2026 appropriations request in alignment with the strategic goals set forth in the Fiscal Years 2024-2028 Strategic Plan: A Library for All . Increasing resources devoted to registration will meet the demands of stakeholders for a new, enhanced and ef fi cient registration system, allowing the Of fi ce to more quickly sunset the eCO system and other work fl ows that rely on legacy platforms, and ensure that all ECS components are integrated with the Library’s fi nancial system. The requested funding enables the Library to update the Congress.gov, loc.gov, and copyright.gov web sites and applications to utilize technology available from commercial cloud providers. The U.S. Copyright Of fi ce (USCO) has an ongoing partnership with the Library of Congress’s Of fi ce of the Chief Information Of fi cer (OCIO) to modernize the USCO’s information technology (IT) systems and services.
